purpose: Document official Yizheng cadastral/registration discovery and bounded anonymous public endpoint behavior without treating map misses or unavailable UI as citywide absence.
assessment: The official Jiangsu government-services portal identifies the Yizheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the implementation body for real-estate registration and gives the Yizheng registration window at West Yuan North Road 39. Public discovery did not establish a current anonymous parcel-vector API or safe ID-plus-geometry response. The national webmap catalog route returned an anti-automation HTTP 418 in the bounded request; no bypass was attempted.
registryAssessment: Local registry custodian is evidenced by the official Yizheng government-services record, but no public local cadastral database, parcel layer, or geometry service was verified; registryFound remains null.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Yizheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau via Jiangsu government-services portal
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official service record names the Yizheng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, gives the registration window at Yangzhou Yizheng West Yuan North Road 39, and describes first registration procedures. It does not publish parcel geometry or an anonymous parcel API.
Official hall guide lists the Natural Resources and Planning real-estate window and contact channel; it is procedural service information, not an open parcel-vector source.

Official catalog documents public geospatial-service discovery and lists Jiangsu among provider filters, but the bounded direct request from this worker was blocked by an anti-automation response; no parcel layer was inferred.
